SELECT COUNT(*) FROM evaluation_management_items m JOIN evaluation_elements e ON e.element_id = m.element_id JOIN evaluation_items i ON i.item_id = e.item_id JOIN evaluation_areas a ON a.area_id = i.area_id WHERE m.management_item_code = #{code} AND m.active_yn = 'Y' AND m.teacher_editable_yn = 'Y' AND e.evaluation_year = #{year} AND e.active_yn = 'Y' AND i.active_yn = 'Y' AND a.area_code = 'EDUCATION' AND a.active_yn = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO education_achievements ( achievement_type, teacher_user_id, organization_code, evaluation_year, management_item_code, achievement_date, achievement_name, achievement_detail, attachment_ref, attachment_ids, created_by, updated_by, request_id ) SELECT 'EMPLOYMENT_RATE_IMPROVEMENT', #{write.teacherUserId}, m.organization_code, #{write.evaluationYear}, TRIM(#{write.request.managementItemCode}), #{write.request.achievementDate}, #{write.request.achievementName}, #{write.detail}, #{write.request.attachmentRef}, CAST(#{write.attachments} AS jsonb), #{write.actorId}, #{write.actorId}, #{write.requestId} FROM organization_user_mappings m WHERE m.user_id = #{write.teacherUserId} AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.mapping_type = 'ORGANIZATION' ORDER BY m.mapping_id LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE education_achievements SET management_item_code = TRIM(#{write.request.managementItemCode}), achievement_date = #{write.request.achievementDate}, achievement_name = #{write.request.achievementName}, achievement_detail = #{write.detail}, attachment_ref = #{write.request.attachmentRef}, attachment_ids = CAST(#{write.attachments} AS jsonb), updated_by = #{write.actorId}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, request_id = #{write.requestId} WHERE achievement_id = #{write.achievementId} AND deleted_yn = 'N' AND achievement_type = 'EMPLOYMENT_RATE_IMPROVEMENT'
